title: Random memeories
content: Does anyone get random memories? Not like your own life memories, but these memories of are like of past lives or dreams that I can not recall they feel so real but I know I have not experienced it in “real” life… one that keeps popping up is that I lived in a huge house with huge fields and a huge garden like you would see those old school 1800 southern houses look like. I keep having this memory of being 4-7 maybe in age and having this Easter egg haunt, I still feel the manic and how happy I was , it’s the strangest flashback and memory. I never had this experience nor close to it or the surroundings in real life, nor have I ever seen that type of back yard before… there are many others but this is one example of this makes any sense….
